text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened just after the New Year, while 
out shopping for daily necessities with 
Admire Vega...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Alright, thanks as always! Here's a bonus 
lottery ticket for you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...A raffle ticket?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"
choice_data_list:
So that's the kind of campaign they were 
running.

So that's the kind of campaign they were 
running, huh?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Looks like you two have tickets. Since 
you're here, why not give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
The countryside you can visit with that 
hot springs ticket has such gorgeous 
scenery! Under a sky full of stars, you're 
guaranteed to feel completely refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: (Looks like he's feeling a bit tempted...)

(Looks like she's feeling a bit 
tempted...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with that—
choice_data_list:
Since you're here, why don't you try it 
out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Admire Vega was the one who got the 
tickets, it would be a waste not to use 
them. When I gently nudged the topic in 
that direction—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Well... it would be a shame to let it go 
to waste, true...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh, care to give it a spin?! Alright then, 
you give it a spin too, young man, put 
your heart into it!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh, care to give it a spin?! Alright then, 
you give it a spin too, miss, put your 
heart into it!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Telepathy...?
choice_data_list: Alright, let's win the grand prize, Ayabe!

Okay, let's win the grand prize together, 
Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, psychic power is a bit of a stretch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, together with Admire Vega, I 
poured all my spirit into cranking the 
raffle wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh... The grand prize? Really...?
choice_data_list: Nice going, Ayabe!
You did it, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was she too overwhelmed with shock? Admire 
Vega stared at the hot springs ticket in 
her hand, falling completely silent for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, when she finally opened her mouth—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Here. ...Will you hold onto this for 
me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I still don't really know. 
...What it is that I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Whether they want to go... or not.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's just... I wouldn't say I have no 
interest in a special starry sky, so...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If it looks like it's going to expire, 
feel free to use it however you like.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's why—
choice_data_list: I'll take good care of it for you.
I'll keep it safe for you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list:
I'll be waiting for the day you can find 
your answer.

I'll be waiting for the day you can find 
your answer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, until the day Admire Vega could 
figure out her own feelings, I decided to 
hold onto the hot spring trip ticket.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: First prize...
choice_data_list: So close……!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...That's already plenty impressive, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It felt really hefty in my hands... It 
should be plenty filling and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we make it the main course for 
dinner?
choice_data_list: Huh? How did this turn into me getting it?
Huh? How did this turn into me getting it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Is that not it?
choice_data_list:
It was your ticket that won it, so it's 
yours.
I won it with your ticket, so it's yours.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Even if you tell me that, I don't know 
what to say.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I don't really eat luxury food like this 
very often, so..."
choice_data_list:
Since we're doing this, let's splurge to 
our heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we picked out a few more things in 
the shopping district before heading back—
choice_data_list: First, here are your hors d'oeuvres.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Are you going to keep that attitude 
going all day today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I treated them to a full-course meal 
featuring hamburg steak as the main dish.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Carrots... What an incredible amount...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Even if we split it between the two of us, 
there's no way we can finish it all...
choice_data_list:
How about splitting it evenly among all of 
us?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: With everyone?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! This is one magnificent carrot 
râpées sandwich...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The seasoning is so light and 
refreshing, I feel like I could eat this 
forever~!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, are you really sure it's 
okay!? You're treating me to so much food!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'm serving this because I want people 
to enjoy it. Please, eat as much as you 
like.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I still owe you for those rice 
balls.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Then don't mind if I do...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, be careful not to choke on your 
food, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Ayabe-senpai. I'll have some 
too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it would... go well with 
coffee, too. ...I'll have one, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, being able to eat it with one hand 
is handy. Looking at what's inside, the 
nutritional efficiency seems pretty solid 
too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Alright! I'm officially taking 
applications for someone to shove this 
into my mouth while I'm researching!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Use at least one of your damn hands, you 
bastard!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Waah, such lovely colors...! May I have 
some to enjoy while reading?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, the destined crew is all here~☆ A 
bond forged by marvelous sandwiches★☆

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Aren't there a few too many people 
gathering...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having said that, Admire Vega looked 
somewhat pleased deep down.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Just one carrot...
choice_data_list: Sorry it wasn't the grand prize...
Sorry it wasn't the grand prize...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"You can't expect to win so easily. Isn't 
it good enough that you didn't lose 
completely?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Not really... This is plenty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened on the way back from that 
lottery draw...

text_block_list.name: Young Sister (Younger)
text_block_list.text: Waaah... Big Sis, I'm sorrrry...

text_block_list.name: Young Sister (Older)
text_block_list.text:
Geez, there's no need to cry! Your big 
sister forgot too, so we're even!

text_block_list.name: Young Sister (Older)
text_block_list.text:
"Still, we can't make curry without 
carrots... Mama's gonna be in trouble..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. Did you forget to buy the carrots?

text_block_list.name: Young Sister (Older)
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... yes. Mama asked me to run an 
errand, but...

text_block_list.name: Young Sister (Younger)
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, i-it-it's all my fault~! 'Cause 
all I did was stare at the sweets, and I 
didn't help out at aaaaall...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Good of you to reflect on your 
actions.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Since you did good... I'll give you a 
carrot.

text_block_list.name: Young Sister (Younger)
text_block_list.text: *hic*... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Sister (Older)
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A-Are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You two play nice together, okay? ...And 
watch out for cars on your way home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so quietly, Admire Vega handed the 
carrot over to the sisters who were 
holding hands tightly...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A losing ticket...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that's just how it goes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's just how it is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to give her usual cool 
response... but I could somehow tell from 
the atmosphere that she was feeling a bit 
down...
